lines.l: But we can cry, but with envy, cause we're uncertain and shy
Just pushing to succeed, we run for the well
While he's got everyone under a spell
Like a hard narcotic has an attic hook
Or a bad car crash where you have to look
While you just shrug, stare at your shoes and say
What's he got that I don't got?
It's all in the mind if you know what I mean
Audacious may be what it takes to make it
You stand out from a crowd of blank faces
Save the caution and common sense
Stand on the fence, you need confidence
To be an icon and do the big interview
When the mic's on, everybody's into you
Hitting the heights, your name up in the bright lights
You're buying front row seats at the prize fight
Rich and famous, moving up the A-list
Nightclub shows, hoop jobs and facelifts
They're not afraid to be exposed or dismissed
Like big chicks with rolls who wear mid-drifts
And they appall you, cause they have the call to
Do the little things that they all do
Who? Rasputin, Warhol, St. Paul, Jefferson, L. Ron Hubbard
Thomas A. Edison, Satchmo, Kuhl Hurt
Godfather used to say, pass the peas
On stage, I sometimes wonder why the crowd doesn't laugh at me
You can't spell it without U-D
You say, how you gonna go and save the best flute
For last on the beat, it's Einstein's audacity
Don't do it, DJ, cutting, breaking
Once again, just in case you didn't hear
What's the name of this song?
The human seems like that, I'm bragging a lot
And if you don't love it, you got to deal with it
